novel_features.name: Cross-engine compare
novel_features.description: See how one query ranks across Google, Bing, Brave, DuckDuckGo and Yahoo: shared domains, domains unique to each engine, and your domain's position on each. Costs 1 credit per engine.
novel_features.rationale: Joins several engine responses into one overlap matrix that no single Autom call returns.
novel_features.example: autom-pp-cli engines compare "serp api pricing" --engines google,bing,brave --domain autom.dev --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a question is about visibility beyond Google or about which engines disagree.

novel_features.name: Rank movers
novel_features.description: List what moved across every tracked keyword since a cutoff: gains, drops, and entries into or exits from the top results. Reads the pages saved earlier by rank check, batch run or compare --save.
novel_features.rationale: Compares saved snapshots in the local store; the API only returns the current page.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for a weekly ranking report once pages have been saved on both sides of the cutoff; on a fresh store it returns a note.

novel_features.name: Geo compare
novel_features.description: Run one query on one engine across several countries and see your domain's position and the shared results per country. Costs 1 credit per country.
novel_features.rationale: Fans out per-country calls (country codes checked against the free finder first) and joins them into one table.
novel_features.example: autom-pp-cli geo compare "serp api pricing" --countries fr,be,ca --domain autom.dev --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the question is how rankings differ between markets.

novel_features.name: Credit ledger
novel_features.description: See your remaining quota, packs and credits plus where your credits went, by keyword, command or engine, with burn rate and days left. Spend covers only the calls made by this CLI; async searches show as pending.
novel_features.rationale: Joins the free usage endpoint with a local ledger of the billed calls this CLI made.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check this before and after large batches to predict spend and find the expensive workload.

novel_features.name: Domain visibility
novel_features.description: See one domain's footprint across every saved keyword: where it appears, average and best position, and top-3 and top-N (--top) counts, optionally against rival domains given with --vs. Reads the pages saved by rank check, batch run or compare --save.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates every saved snapshot in the local store; no single API call covers more than one query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to compare a brand with competitors across a whole keyword set that you have already saved.

novel_features.name: News watch
novel_features.description: Get only the news articles about a brand or keyword that earlier watches have not shown. Returned articles are marked as seen; --peek previews without marking. Costs 1 credit.
novel_features.rationale: Deduplicates Google News results against the articles already stored locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Schedule this for brand monitoring without re-reading the same articles.

narrative.headline: Every Autom search engine from the terminal, plus saved rank history, cross-engine and cross-country comparison, and per-engine credit spend from a local ledger.
narrative.value_prop: Search Google, Bing, Brave, DuckDuckGo and Yahoo through one key, with every documented parameter as a flag. rank check, batch run and the --save flag of the compare commands save each results page locally, so rank movers and visibility can answer what changed and where a domain stands, and credits shows where your credits went. Read-only: it searches and reads account usage; nothing on the Autom account is created or changed.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the CLI is installed (no network, no credits)
Free: see your remaining quota, packs and credits

quickstart.command: autom-pp-cli rank check autom.dev --query "serp api pricing" --country fr
quickstart.comment: Where a domain ranks for a keyword, saved for later comparisons

quickstart.command: autom-pp-cli engines compare "serp api pricing" --engines google,bing,brave --domain autom.dev
quickstart.comment: Same query on several engines at once
What moved since last week, from the local history

troubleshoots.fix: Autom signals rate limits with 401, and the CLI exits 7 rather than 4: wait and retry, or lower batch concurrency with --concurrency 1
Set AUTOM_API_KEY to a valid key from the Autom dashboard, then run autom-pp-cli usage (free) to confirm the key
Out of credits: check autom-pp-cli credits, top up, or enable Auto Top-Up in the dashboard
Drop --page on autom-pp-cli bing; the Autom endpoint currently fails when page is set
Autom can take up to 60 seconds; raise --timeout, or add --is-async and poll autom-pp-cli jobs get <job-id> --wait

troubleshoots.symptom: sync does nothing and search costs credits
troubleshoots.fix: Every Autom endpoint needs a query, so sync has nothing to crawl and search runs a billed live web-search in the default auto mode; pass --data-source local to read only saved data, and use rank history, rank movers, visibility or serp diff for offline work

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to fetch live search engine results from Google, Bing, Brave, DuckDuckGo or Yahoo, to track where a domain ranks over time, to compare rankings across engines or countries, or to monitor news about a brand. It is also the right tool to check Autom credit balance and spend before running large batches.
anti_triggers: Crawling or scraping the content of the result pages themselves; use a scraping API for that
Keyword search volume or backlink data; Autom returns results pages only
Writing or changing anything on an Autom account; the API is read-only apart from billing in the dashboard

recipes.title: Narrow a Google search to links
recipes.explanation: Keep only positions and links from a large results payload. Costs 1 credit.

recipes.title: Check and save a ranking
recipes.command: autom-pp-cli rank check autom.dev --query "serp api pricing" --country fr
recipes.explanation: Position of a domain for one keyword; the page is saved for rank history and movers. Costs 1 credit.

recipes.title: Track a keyword list
recipes.command: autom-pp-cli batch run --keywords "serp api pricing,google search scraper" --domain autom.dev --agent
recipes.explanation: Checks the balance first, then saves every page. Costs 1 credit per distinct keyword/engine/country/lang.

recipes.title: Weekly ranking report
recipes.explanation: Gains, drops, entries and exits versus pages saved 7+ days ago by rank check or batch run. Free: reads saved pages.

recipes.title: Compare markets
recipes.command: autom-pp-cli geo compare "serp api pricing" --countries fr,be,ca --domain autom.dev
recipes.explanation: Position per country and the results the countries share. Costs 3 credits (one per country).

recipes.title: Brand news without repeats
recipes.explanation: Only articles earlier watches have not shown, then marks them as seen. Costs 1 credit.

how many Autom credits are left
